_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes (preconditioner names are a five-item enumeration). The catalog advertised PETSc fieldsplit, AMG and ILU as preconditioners for this backend; for the default numpy/'fem' storage none of those names exists. dune-fem forwards 'linear.preconditioning.method' unchecked to DUNE's parameter reader, so a plausible name fails at SCHEME CONSTRUCTION with a RuntimeError naming 'fem.solver.linear.preconditioning.method' and enumerating none, sor, ssor, gauss-seidel, jacobi. The fixture harvests that message for ilu/amg/fieldsplit and then proves each of the five advertised names really builds and solves. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03; the same message was hit independently from a Stokes script and from a Poisson script.
